name: Dawn
best_known_for: Only spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial worlds — Vesta (2011-2012) then Ceres (2015-2018) via three NSTAR ion thrusters
credit: Discovery-class mission with three NSTAR xenon ion thrusters that generated the 11 km/s of total delta-v needed to enter orbit around Vesta, escape, cruise three years, and enter orbit around Ceres. Mapped both bodies in unprecedented detail (Vesta: 5300 images at 16 m/px, southern Rheasilvia basin; Ceres: bright Cerealia Facula spots in Occator crater, ammoniated phyllosilicates, cryovolcanism at Ahuna Mons). Mission ended 2018-10-31 when reaction-control hydrazine was exhausted; spacecraft remains in a stable 35 × 4000 km orbit around Ceres.
